title: Joseph the Dreamer Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Joseph the Dreamer Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Joseph Bible crossword: the coat of many colours, the pit, Potiphar, Pharaoh’s dreams and the seven years of plenty. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: A favourite son, a coat that says so, and eleven brothers who have had enough of his dreams. Joseph the Dreamer runs the length of the story — the pit, the Ishmeelites, Potiphar's house, the prison, the butler and the baker, and the morning Pharaoh sends for a Hebrew who can read a dream about cattle and corn.
The KJV calls it a coat of many colours, with the u, which is the kind of detail this app is built on. The closing verse comes early, at the moment the coat is given and the trouble begins.

clues.text: Joseph’s coat was of many of these
His father, who loved him more than all his children
Land he was carried down into
Officer of Pharaoh who bought him

verseText: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
